contingency_plan.description: What the patch implements if the executable check FAILS — a concrete alternative approach for exactly this question's part of the work.

direction_change_node_ids.description: The committed direction node ids a check failure would invalidate; empty unless rewind_class is requires_direction_change. Use exact ids from the anchored nodes' tree.

rewind_class.description: in_patch: the contingency touches only files/patch items. requires_direction_change: a check failure would invalidate committed direction nodes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Child acceptance criteria copied from the deliberated approach.

child_key.description: Stable local key unique within this split. MUST match ^[a-z0-9_]+$ - lowercase letters, digits, and underscores ONLY; NO hyphens, spaces, or uppercase (e.g. authority_closure, not authority-closure).

or_group.description: Shared OR group id; empty means AND.

reason.description: Required reason for depends/excludes; optional for part_of.

state.description: Lifecycle state or target-declared milestone; empty defaults to accepted for depends.

to.description: Target node key or serial for depends/part_of; empty otherwise.

when.description: Total state predicate; empty means always active.

with.description: Excluded peer key for excludes; empty otherwise.

risks.description: Must-address risks handled by this child.

scope_item_ids.description: Parent scope item ids covered exactly by this child.

stage_name.description: Rolling-wave stage this child belongs to.

systems.description: Implementation systems touched by this child.

ux_acceptance_tests.description: UX acceptance tests covered by this child.

parent_retained_scope_ids.description: Scope item ids retained by the parent integration gate.

split_mode.description: Whether the approved technical approach is already one bounded leaf or must split.

deliverable_requirements.description: One requirement for each goal whose determination is true.

deliverable.description: Canonical deliverable text shared with the production obligation.

id.description: Stable identity of this deliverable requirement.

production_obligation_id.description: Identity of the one cross-linked production obligation.

referee_goal_id.description: Identity of the one referee goal requiring this deliverable.

goals.description: Canonical referee goals with explicit deliverable determinations.

id.description: Stable referee-goal identity supplied by canonical root preparation.

requires_deliverable.description: Explicitly true when this referee criterion requires a produced deliverable.

patch_plan.description: Executable root items whose obligation arrays form an exact partition.

item_id.description: Stable identity of one executable root patch-plan item.

production_obligation_ids.description: The exact production obligations assigned to this item.

production_obligations.description: One producer obligation cross-linked to each deliverable requirement.

deliverable.description: Canonical deliverable text shared with the requirement.

deliverable_requirement_id.description: Identity of the paired deliverable requirement.

eligibility_predicate.description: Predicate a prospective producer can evaluate for itself.

referee_goal_id.description: Identity of the paired referee goal.

replacement_reason.description: Empty for an initial obligation; otherwise the factual replacement reason.

replaces_obligation_id.description: Empty for an initial obligation; otherwise the exact predecessor identity.

applicability.description: applies means the patch series must specify this aspect; not_applicable means specification_body is the reason it does not apply.

ascii_working_slug.description: Lowercase ASCII branch slug using only a-z, 0-9, and hyphen, from 3 to 48 characters.

affected_area_platform.description: role=scope/routing boundary; belongs=product area, repo/module, version, target surface; must_not=the build-platform choice (that is tech_stack), general context, research notes; owner=either; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

alternatives_considered.description: role=early design space when already known; belongs=obvious alternatives, prior art, "do nothing"; must_not=being a required entrance field; owner=grounding; required_at=optional; lint_scope=context

background_facts.description: role=bounded objective context; belongs=only facts needed to interpret the request (the named thing, its domain, existing constraints); must_not=source lists, research transcript, motivation, proposal, staff/lore/full-history; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=context

constraints_assumptions.description: role=planning limits and unverified beliefs; belongs=compatibility constraints, budget/time assumptions, user assumptions, recorded requester-decision assumptions; must_not=proven facts without uncertainty labels; owner=grounding; required_at=optional; lint_scope=context

desired_outcomes_success.description: role=success signals; belongs=acceptance criteria, success metrics, expected result; must_not=implementation plan; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

grounding_provenance.description: role=research audit trail; belongs=search notes, source-derived facts, confidence, unresolved verification gaps; must_not=content consumed downstream as product requirement nouns; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=context

intended_users_or_jobs.description: role=who benefits and the job/outcome; belongs=personas, user/job story, benefit; must_not=staff lists, brand lore, implementation tasks; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

non_goals_out_of_scope.description: role=prevent scope creep; belongs=things reasonably expected but excluded; must_not=rejected implementation alternatives; owner=grounding; required_at=optional; lint_scope=context

open_questions.description: role=blockers for patch series drafting; belongs=unknowns, choices needing requester/product decision; must_not=future nice-to-haves already out of scope; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=context

problem_or_motivation.description: role=why the change is needed; belongs=current pain/opportunity/inadequacy; must_not=encyclopedia facts that do not explain the problem; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

proposal_hint.description: role=a requested solution captured WITHOUT treating it as decided; belongs="use React", "like X", "add multiplayer"; must_not=final design/specification; owner=requester; required_at=optional; lint_scope=context

raw_request.description: role=preserve the original ask verbatim; belongs=one-line/rough request, attachments; must_not=cleaned-up research prose or inferred requirements; owner=requester; required_at=entrance; lint_scope=context

references.description: role=external pointers; belongs=URLs, docs, prior issues, source labels; must_not=summaries, quotations, conclusions; owner=either; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=context

request_type.description: role=route workflow; belongs=feature|bug|research|game_app|refactor|policy|unknown; must_not=requirements details; owner=either; required_at=optional; lint_scope=context

tech_stack.description: role=what the deliverable is built ON; belongs=structured sub-tags {build_strategy, engine, framework, language, platform, rationale, provenance}; platform is the user-facing runtime target such as browser or lightweight desktop, or for a deliverable that is not a user-facing product, the deliverable's own target surface such as git-committed specification documents; must_not=from_scratch as a silent default; scope/routing; domain facts; org verifier mechanisms such as functional_check or codex in platform (worktree too, when the deliverable is a user-facing product); owner=either; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

platform.description: User-facing runtime target, for example browser or lightweight desktop. Org verification constraints belong in constraints, not here.

user_experience_requirements.description: role=patch-series-altitude observable graphics/UI/UX contract derived by grounding; belongs=observable behavior, states, feedback channels, named-reference and genre conventions, accessibility baselines, and screenshot/interaction/playtest checks that prove perceivability; must_not=exact palettes, sprite dimensions, typography, component names, file names, implementation details, decorative claims with no observable effect, or research prose; owner=grounding; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target

working_title.description: role=short tracking handle; belongs=concise noun/verb phrase; must_not=full proposal/rationale/domain essay; owner=either; required_at=patch_series_handoff; lint_scope=target
